events.title: Operation Employment Career Fair
events.description:
Join us aboard the historic USS Yorktown for the Operation Employment Career Fair!

This event connects veterans, military family members, and job seekers directly to employers across a range of industries. Admission is free and open to the public.

  • Explore open positions in the Tri-County area
  • Gain insight into new career paths
  • Make connections with hiring managers who value your background and skills.


View Participating Employers & Event Details

 

Proudly presented by the SC Department of Employment and Workforce, SC Works Trident, SC Department of Veterans’ Affairs, SC Vocational Rehabilitation, and Patriots Point Naval & Maritime Museum.

events.title: “Wednesday Works” Multi-Employer Hiring Event
events.description:
Meet hiring employers face-to-face, fast-track job searching, and apply on-the-spot at “Wednesday Works.”
No appointment needed! Resume support and printing are available on-site.


About “Wednesday Works”

“Wednesday Works” is a series of hiring events that will be held every other Wednesday. Each event will feature three to four employers that are actively hiring across Berkeley, Charleston or Dorchester County.

The goal of “Wednesday Works” is to bring job seekers face-to-face with employers for an opportunity to establish genuine connections and discuss work opportunities.
